scope: Thirty source-linked sentence patterns from ten fully read user-supplied CCR/JTO PDFs. Nine use verified PMIDs; the RET-MAP article remains DOI-locked and uses source_id without an invented PMID.
verification: All wording was checked against the local extraction and the rendered physical page. Whitespace, line-break hyphenation and extraction glyphs may be normalized; scientific values and claim direction are unchanged. Templates accept user facts only.

papers.title: Co-occurring EGFR p.E709X Mutation Mediates Primary Resistance to the Third-Generation EGFR-TKIs in EGFR p.G719X-Mutant Patients with Advanced NSCLC
papers.boundary: Retrospective regimen-specific association with model concordance; afatinib null comparisons do not establish equivalence and one body-text P-value conflicts with the abstract and Figure 2C.

papers.title: Drug-specific resistance mechanisms to RET inhibitors in RET fusion-positive NSCLC
papers.boundary: Drug- and fusion-context-specific preclinical resistance; AlphaFold 3 is hypothesis-generating and a response in one patient does not establish a sequencing standard.

papers.title: Co-occurring Alterations in the RAS-MAPK Pathway Limit Response to MET Inhibitor Treatment in MET Exon 14 Skipping Mutation-Positive Lung Cancer
papers.boundary: The baseline pathway contrast is nominally significant but fails multiplicity correction; cfDNA dynamics and model rescue are not radiographic patient efficacy.

papers.title: Second- and third-line outcomes after selective RET inhibitor failure in RET fusion-positive metastatic lung cancer: A real-world analysis from the RET-MAP registry
papers.boundary: DOI-locked pending an authoritative PMID; retrospective small-cohort regimen comparisons do not establish added immunotherapy benefit, equivalence, or zero efficacy.

papers.title: The Impact of Durvalumab on Local-Regional Control in Stage III NSCLCs Treated With Chemoradiation and on KEAP1-NFE2L2-Mutant Tumors
papers.boundary: Retrospective noncontemporaneous cohorts; the absence of an association under durvalumab is not proof of mitigation without a treatment-by-genotype interaction.

papers.title: LKB1 Deficiency Renders NSCLC Cells Sensitive to ERK Inhibitors
papers.boundary: Entirely preclinical conditional vulnerability; PI3K-AKT activation can abolish monotherapy sensitivity and no patient efficacy is established.

papers.title: LKB1 Down-Modulation by miR-17 Identifies Patients With NSCLC Having Worse Prognosis Eligible for Energy-Stress-Based Treatments
papers.boundary: The PDX volume endpoint was negative despite biomarker changes; the clinical association is prognostic and context-restricted, not treatment-predictive.

papers.title: Comprehensive Analysis of TP53 and KEAP1 Mutations and Their Impact on Survival in Localized- and Advanced-Stage NSCLC
papers.boundary: Prognostic only, with stage- and mutation-class-dependent associations and separate gene-model denominators; no treatment prediction is supported.

papers.title: Discovery of Biomarkers of Resistance to Immune Checkpoint Blockade in NSCLC Using High-Plex Digital Spatial Profiling
papers.boundary: Compartment-specific treatment-associated evidence; no randomized comparator or treatment-by-marker interaction supports a predictive claim.

papers.title: KEAP1/NFE2L2 Pathway Signature Outperforms KEAP1/NFE2L2 Mutation Status and Reveals Alternative Pathway-Activating Mutations in NSCLC
papers.boundary: Held-out within-center evaluation, not external validation; nominal pooled survival does not establish independent prognostic superiority, and bulk immune estimates are not cell counts.

source.source_sentence: Patients harboring the concomitant EGFR p.E709X mutation displayed a similar tumor mutation burden (TMB) compared with those without EGFR p.E709X mutation (P = 0.16).

records.use_scenario: Report an unchanged omics feature beside a recurrent compound genotype.
records.rewrite_template: [Alteration A] recurrently co-occurred with [alteration B], whereas [omics feature] was not detectably different between groups (P=[ ]).
records.evidence_boundary: A nonsignificant contrast is not proof that the distributions are identical; preserve assay, group and uncertainty.

source.source_sentence: Co-occurring EGFR p.E709X mutations exerted a detrimental effect on outcomes in patients treated with the third-generation EGFR-TKIs (G719X/E709X vs. G719X, ORR: 0.00% vs. 47.62%, P < 0.001; mPFS: 7.18 vs. 14.2 months, P = 0.042).

records.use_scenario: Link response-rate and time-to-event findings within one molecular-treatment stratum.
records.rewrite_template: Within the [treatment] cohort, [alteration] was associated with a lower [response endpoint] and shorter [time-to-event endpoint], a pattern concordant with [orthogonal evidence].
records.evidence_boundary: Retrospective subgroup association; no randomized head-to-head comparison or formal treatment-by-genotype interaction.

source.source_sentence: Conversely, no significant difference was found in the treatment efficacy of afatinib between EGFR p.G719X/E709X and EGFR p.G719X patients.

records.use_scenario: Describe an imprecise null efficacy comparison without claiming equivalence.
records.rewrite_template: Neither [endpoint 1] nor [endpoint 2] differed detectably under [regimen]; however, the small subgroup and uncertainty preclude an equivalence claim.
records.evidence_boundary: Use abstract/Figure 2C P=0.99, not the conflicting body glyph P<0.99; nonsignificance is not equivalence.

source.source_sentence: Neither WT RET nor A883V-mutant RET supported Ba/F3 cell proliferation in the absence of IL-3, nor did they elevate phosphorylated RET levels, indicating that the A883V mutation alone does not have oncogenic activity.

records.use_scenario: Separate drug resistance in a fusion context from autonomous oncogenic activity.
records.rewrite_template: Although [variant] altered drug sensitivity in [fusion/model context], it did not support [growth assay] or increase [signaling readout] when tested alone.
records.evidence_boundary: Restricted to the tested model and assay; absence of IL-3-independent growth does not prove no biological effect in every context.

source.source_sentence: However, these AF3 predictions are hypothesis-generating, and any causal relationship between fusion-partner-imposed kinase-domain geometry and drug resistance should be interpreted with caution.

records.use_scenario: Present a computational structural explanation after functional observations.
records.rewrite_template: The predicted [conformation/interface] offers a structural hypothesis for [context-dependent phenotype], but direct experimental validation is required.
records.evidence_boundary: A predicted conformation is not direct structural observation or causal validation.

source.source_sentence: The patient remained on pralsetinib for 22 months until progression of bone metastasis was observed.

records.use_scenario: Use an individual durable response as concordance with a preclinical resistance profile.
records.rewrite_template: A durable response in one patient was clinically concordant with the preclinical profile but cannot establish comparative efficacy or a preferred sequence.
records.evidence_boundary: One patient cannot define population efficacy, resistance frequency, or treatment sequencing.

source.source_sentence: There remained a trend towards more common detection of RAS-MAPK pathway alterations before treatment in METex14-mutated NSCLC (37.7% vs 19.0%, p-value 0.0297, q-value = 0.297 with correction for multiple hypothesis testing by Benjamini-Hochberg for FDR < 20%).

records.use_scenario: Report a nominal omics contrast that does not survive multiplicity correction.
records.rewrite_template: [Alterations] were nominally more frequent in [group A], but the contrast did not withstand multiplicity correction (q=[ ]), supporting a hypothesis rather than confirmed enrichment.
records.evidence_boundary: The q value controls the claim; do not call this statistically significant enrichment.

source.source_sentence: Both MET second-site mutations and RAS pathway alterations are newly detectable following MET TKI treatment.

records.use_scenario: Describe alterations becoming detectable in paired post-treatment liquid biopsies.
records.rewrite_template: In paired samples, [alteration class] became newly detectable after treatment, consistent with treatment-associated selection but not establishing clonal origin.
records.evidence_boundary: cfDNA cannot determine when or in which anatomical site the clone arose.

source.source_sentence: Co-treatment with crizotinib and the MEK inhibitor trametinib in order to block both MET signaling and downstream MAPK pathway signaling restored sensitivity to treatment.

records.use_scenario: Write a mechanistic rescue after engineered resistance.
records.rewrite_template: [Perturbation] increased resistance to [drug], whereas cotargeting [bypass pathway] restored sensitivity in the tested model.
records.evidence_boundary: Model rescue supports mechanism in that system; it is not a demonstrated clinical combination benefit.

source.source_sentence: Outcomes were similar with chemotherapy alone versus chemo-immunotherapy for rwPFS (5.9 vs 6.8 months; HR 1.05, p=0.903) and OS (18.5 vs 13.7 months; HR 0.83, p=0.674).

records.use_scenario: Report no clear added effect in a small nonrandomized regimen comparison.
records.rewrite_template: Outcomes were numerically similar between [regimens] (HR [ ], 95% CI [ ]; P=[ ]); the data provide no clear evidence of an added effect but do not establish equivalence.
records.evidence_boundary: Wide intervals and retrospective selection prevent added-benefit and equivalence claims.

source.source_sentence: Three patients had rwPFS beyond 24 months with chemo-immunotherapy, all after short first-line SRI exposure.

records.use_scenario: Acknowledge rare prolonged control despite an inconclusive cohort comparison.
records.rewrite_template: Despite the absence of a cohort-level signal, [n] patients experienced control beyond [duration], highlighting a long tail that warrants biomarker investigation.
records.evidence_boundary: The outcome cannot be attributed to immunotherapy because chemotherapy was concurrent and the subgroup was selected.

source.source_sentence: Among 32 patients receiving third-line therapy, taxane with or without antiangiogenic therapy was most common, with no responses and median rwPFS of 1.5 months (95% CI 0.8-NR).

records.use_scenario: Describe poor observed activity without asserting zero efficacy.
records.rewrite_template: No responses were observed among [n] evaluable patients, and median [endpoint] was [ ]; these data indicate poor observed activity in a small cohort rather than proof of zero efficacy.
records.evidence_boundary: Retain the evaluable denominator; an observed zero is not a population-level zero effect.

source.source_sentence: The 12-month PFS rate was 59% in the cCRT and durvalumab group compared to 42% in the cCRT alone group (p = 0.019).

records.use_scenario: Report an outcome difference between retrospective treatment-era cohorts.
records.rewrite_template: At [landmark], [endpoint] was [value] with [regimen B] and [value] with [regimen A] ([reported test]).
records.evidence_boundary: Noncontemporaneous retrospective comparison; do not write randomized treatment efficacy.

source.source_sentence: On univariate analysis, KEAP1/NFE2L2 tumor mutational status did not associate with local-regional control outcomes (p = 0.545).

records.use_scenario: Contrast a genotype association across treatment contexts without claiming reversal.
records.rewrite_template: Whereas [genotype] was associated with poorer [outcome] under [regimen A], this association was not detected under [regimen B]; a treatment-by-genotype interaction was not tested.
records.evidence_boundary: Absence of a within-cohort association is not evidence that treatment neutralized the genotype effect.

source.source_sentence: The presence of a coexisting KEAP1, STK11, PBRM1 and SMARCA4 mutations, nor a KRAS mutation associated with local-regional outcomes (p = 0.75 and p = 0.73, respectively).

records.use_scenario: Report a null composite-gene covariate while preventing gene-specific overinterpretation.
records.rewrite_template: Neither [biomarker] nor the composite co-alteration variable was associated with [outcome], although the uncertainty does not exclude a clinically relevant effect.
records.evidence_boundary: A pooled KEAP1/STK11/PBRM1/SMARCA4 variable cannot support an STK11-specific conclusion.

source.source_sentence: SCH772984 treatment gave a marked, statistically significant response in LKB1-deficient cells compared to the parental cell line.

records.use_scenario: State a genotype-dependent drug response in engineered models.
records.rewrite_template: Genetic ablation of [gene] sensitized isogenic models to [drug], whereas [restoration/control] reduced that response.
records.evidence_boundary: Preclinical model result; do not infer patient response or a clinical biomarker cutoff.

source.source_sentence: As predicted, SCH772984 resulted in an equal lack of response in clones and in the parental cell line.

records.use_scenario: Explain loss of an otherwise genotype-linked response under pathway activation.
records.rewrite_template: Under constitutive [bypass pathway] activation, the genotype-linked response to [drug] was not observed in either engineered or parental cells.
records.evidence_boundary: A context-dependent null result does not invalidate sensitivity in other molecular backgrounds.

source.source_sentence: Co-treatment with the PI3K p110alpha-specific inhibitor PIK-75 restored the sensitivity of LKB1-deficient cells to the ERK inhibitor whereas no effect was observed for the parental line.

records.use_scenario: Describe restoration of response by pathway cotargeting.
records.rewrite_template: Cotargeting [bypass pathway] restored sensitivity to [primary inhibitor] selectively in [genotype] models.
records.evidence_boundary: Model-level rescue does not establish clinical combination efficacy or safety.

source.source_sentence: Metformin treatment induced no significant decrease in tumor volume in both models. Nevertheless, metformin treatment resulted in a significant decrease in MIB-1 staining and pS6/S6 expression ratio only in the LKB1WT/miR17L PDX.

records.use_scenario: Preserve a negative efficacy endpoint while reporting orthogonal biological activity.
records.rewrite_template: Although [treatment] did not significantly reduce tumor volume, biomarker-dependent [apoptosis/signaling] changes indicated biological activity without demonstrated antitumor efficacy.
records.evidence_boundary: Biomarker modulation cannot replace the negative tumor-volume endpoint.

source.source_sentence: The prognostic role of miR-17 expression level on OS was not observed in the whole series (p = 0.1). Of note, considering only LKB1WT patients, miR-17H significantly discriminated patients with worse OS (p = 0.004).

records.use_scenario: Report a subgroup-restricted prognostic association after an overall null result.
records.rewrite_template: [Marker] was not associated with [endpoint] overall; however, a context-restricted association emerged in [molecular subgroup].
records.evidence_boundary: Preserve subgroup status and avoid implying a treatment interaction or universal effect.

source.source_sentence: The multivariable analysis, adjusted for stage and histotype, revealed that miR-17H expression still retains the negative predictive value within LKB1WT patients and not in the whole series (HR: 3.1, p = 0.049 and HR: 1.9, p = 0.128, respectively).

records.use_scenario: Report an imprecise adjusted subgroup estimate cautiously.
records.rewrite_template: After adjustment for [covariates], the association persisted in [subgroup] but not in the overall cohort; the borderline estimate warrants cautious interpretation.
records.evidence_boundary: Despite the source's word predictive, no treatment interaction was evaluated; use prognostic terminology.

source.source_sentence: Only a subset of patients received KEAP1 analysis (3022 of 6297 cases). Therefore, to compensate for different group sizes, separate multivariable analyses for TP53 and for KEAP1 were performed.

records.use_scenario: Explain separate genomic survival models when testing denominators differ.
records.rewrite_template: Because [gene/assay] results were available for only [n/N], separate multivariable models were fitted for [gene A] and [gene B].
records.evidence_boundary: Keep the gene-specific denominators explicit; separate models do not make populations identical.

source_fragments: In 4779 patients with advanced-stage tumors, TP53 mutations did not predict outcome in univariable analysis.
KEAP1 mutations remained a negative prognostic factor.

records.use_scenario: Contrast mutation-class prognosis across localized and advanced disease.
records.rewrite_template: In [stage A], [mutation class] retained an adverse association after adjustment, whereas the same association was not observed in [stage B].
records.evidence_boundary: Prognostic, not treatment-predictive; preserve stage, mutation class, model and testing denominator.

source.source_sentence: Those with KEAP1-mutant tumors with co-occurring TP53 missense mutations had longer overall survival than those with KEAP1-mutant tumors with wild-type or truncating TP53 mutations.

records.use_scenario: Describe longer observed survival in a genomic co-alteration subgroup.
records.rewrite_template: Within [driver]-mutant disease, the [co-alteration] subgroup had longer observed survival; without treatment-level data, this remains hypothesis-generating.
records.evidence_boundary: Do not call the co-alteration protective or treatment modifying.

source.source_sentence: Of 71 candidate protein biomarkers, CD66b in the CD45+CD68 molecular compartment (immune stroma) predicted significantly shorter OS (HR 1.31, p=0.016) and was chosen for validation.

records.use_scenario: State the measured spatial compartment and orthogonal validation sequence.
records.rewrite_template: Using compartment-specific spatial profiling, [marker] in [compartment] was associated with [outcome] and was advanced to orthogonal validation.
records.evidence_boundary: Use association rather than prediction unless a treatment interaction establishes predictive utility.

source.source_sentence: The difference in PFS, although favoring CD66b low cases, was not statistically significant.

records.use_scenario: Report a reproducible OS association alongside a nonsignificant PFS result.
records.rewrite_template: Although [PFS endpoint] was directionally unfavorable, it was imprecise and nonsignificant; the more reproducible [OS endpoint] warrants cautious interpretation.
records.evidence_boundary: Do not merge OS and PFS into a uniformly positive resistance claim.

source.source_sentence: Using the DSP technique, we have discovered that CD66b expression is indicative of resistance to ICI therapy in NSCLC.

records.use_scenario: Translate an indicative biomarker claim into interaction-aware language.
records.rewrite_template: The treated-versus-nontreated pattern is compatible with treatment-context relevance, but the absence of an interaction analysis precludes a predictive claim.
records.evidence_boundary: Non-ICI cohort nonsignificance does not prove absence of general prognosis; no randomization or formal interaction was reported.

source.source_sentence: The final prediction of KEAP1/NFE2L2 mutations in the validation data set (n = 108) resulted in an AUC of 0.895 (CI: 0.8-0.979) and an accuracy of 0.87 (0.792-0.927).

records.use_scenario: Report signature discrimination in a held-out subset.
records.rewrite_template: The signature discriminated [label/state] in a held-out cohort, with AUC [ ] and accuracy [ ], but was not evaluated against an independent functional gold standard.
records.evidence_boundary: The split came from one center; call this held-out internal evaluation, not external validation.

source.source_sentence: Neither in LUAD (p = 0.062) nor in LUSC (p = 0.419) could the K1N2 score significantly identify patient subgroups with poor outcome; when analyzing patients regardless of histology, only the signature achieved significant results (p = 0.047).

records.use_scenario: Qualify pooled nominal survival separation with negative within-histology analyses.
records.rewrite_template: The score achieved nominal pooled survival separation, whereas within-[histology] comparisons were nonsignificant; independent prognostic superiority was not established.
records.evidence_boundary: No multivariable incremental-performance comparison or external prognostic validation was reported.

source.source_sentence: We calculated the StromalScore and the ImmuneScore using the ESTIMATE method as a general estimation of increased tumor stroma and immune cell infiltration.

records.use_scenario: Describe immune-state estimates derived from bulk expression.
records.rewrite_template: Higher [signature] values were associated with lower expression-derived immune estimates, consistent with an immune-depleted transcriptional state rather than direct measurement of immune-cell abundance.
records.evidence_boundary: ESTIMATE/xCell outputs are bulk-expression inferences, not measured cell counts, spatial localization, or treatment response.
